title: Grid inline new row and board quick-create offer every option of a state_machine field that declares initialStates
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. Found by the #27763 card thread (report 6515887379, `out_of_scope_findings`). PR #27969 narrows a create FORM's state-machine select to its `initialStates` through `gateFormFields`, which is every form layout. Two create surfaces outside forms were not covered.
Reach: any object with a blocking `state_machine` validation that declares `initialStates` (the showcase `project_status_flow`, `initialStates: ['planned']`), created from the list grid's inline new row or from a board's quick-create.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "grid inline new row kanban quick create state machine initialStates options" → #25933 (closed; the edit form and board moves) and #3433 (closed; seed replay). Neither covers this.

## Observed
The grid's inline new row offers every option of the state field. A board's quick-create creates a record in the column's state, whatever that state is. On a column whose state is not in `initialStates`, the server refuses the insert with `invalid_initial_state`, after the user has typed the record.

## Wanted
Both surfaces read `stateMachineInitialValues` (`@object-ui/core`, added by PR #27969 beside `stateMachineNextValues`):
- The inline new row's select offers only the initial states.
- A board offers quick-create only on columns whose state is an initial state, or says why not. ⛔ No second reading of the rule.

Dedupe words: initialStates grid new row, kanban quick create initial state, invalid_initial_state board, stateMachineInitialValues.

Related: #27763, PR #27969, #25933.
